decisions.issues: Forced pick (hand retouch, ear drop removed). Remaining faults: (1) Nagoji's left ear is visible but now shows no gold stud at all; the retouch took out the stud along with the drop, so the bible's 'small gold ear stud' is missing. (5) Her head sits near the top edge, above the middle half of the frame. The open sky in the upper middle and right (x about 0.45 to 0.95, y 0.05 to 0.35, broken only by palm crowns) gives room for all three lettering lines. Nagoji's line can go above him in the sky, and Padmini's two lines to the right of her head, clear of the faces. No painted text, balloons, gore or anachronisms. Hands and anatomy are sound. Padmini's black hair, gold jewellery and cream gold-border sari with no blouse match her bible row.
